sourceTitle: His Glorious Appearing: An Exposition of Matthew Twenty-Four
description: "His Glorious Appearing: An Exposition of Matthew Twenty-Four" by James White is a religious treatise written in the late 19th century. The book delves into the biblical prophecies related to the second coming of Christ as articulated in Matthew 24, exploring themes of warning, faithfulness, and the signs that indicate the nearness of the end times.
